boundary_structure.distinction_note: There are exactly 7 distinct boundary failure IDs (FAIL-13, FAIL-26, FAIL-27, FAIL-30, FAIL-38, FAIL-44, FAIL-45) organized into 4 physical boundary families. Reports must not conflate the 4 boundary families with the 7 individual boundary IDs.

FAMILY_1_OPTICAL_REID_DRIFT.name: Optical & Specular ReID Uniformity Drift
FAMILY_1_OPTICAL_REID_DRIFT.description: Uniform high-vis worker clothing and specular reflections causing visual appearance feature ambiguity.

FAMILY_2_FAR_FIELD_RAY_DILUTION.name: Far-Field Monocular Ray Dilution & Target Miss
FAMILY_2_FAR_FIELD_RAY_DILUTION.description: Monocular ground-projection ray divergence and detector sensitivity drop beyond 8.5m - 10.0m range.

FAMILY_3_NON_PLANAR_ELEVATION_WARP.name: Non-Planar Floor Gradients & Ramp Elevation Warping
FAMILY_3_NON_PLANAR_ELEVATION_WARP.description: Floor inclines and ramps (> 1.5 deg - 3.0 deg) violating planar homography assumption.

FAMILY_4_CAMERA_PITCH_DEFLECTION_DRIFT.name: Camera Mount Mechanical Deflection & Pitch Drift
FAMILY_4_CAMERA_PITCH_DEFLECTION_DRIFT.description: Gantry vibration and mechanical deflection causing pitch drift exceeding 0.35 deg tolerance.
